summary: All 7 ACs implemented as written and tested; no contract-changing scope creep. AC1 table nodes with align attribute + GFM serializer + HTML fallback + toolbar/table bar; AC2 task lists tight-serialized; AC3 inline image round-trips; AC4 fence = max(3, longest run + 1); AC5 MermaidCodeBlockView debounced preview, code stays editable, securityLevel strict via MermaidRenderer; AC6 only table/task-list lossy rules removed, footnotes and ref-links still flagged; AC7 markdownEditorElements.test.ts covers every element, identity + idempotence. Minor: image-insert toolbar button and column-alignment buttons added beyond the plan (supporting AC1, optional); extra dependency @tiptap/extension-code-block exact-pinned 3.32.0 is required to override the code block.
